_comment_globs: Every path glob here resolves against the mutated project's own directory
(managed/Tf2DemoSalvage.Cli), not the solution root and not the invocation
directory. A glob written from the repo root matches nothing, and Stryker does not
warn - it runs and reports a score for whatever it did find. See

was extracted into CommandLine and ProgressBar precisely so it could be tested
